line.en: the sun comes up around 07:50 this week. the head is a short climb from howth station on the dart; be at the top before the light.
line.de: die sonne geht diese woche gegen 7:50 uhr auf. der kopf liegt einen kurzen aufstieg vom bahnhof howth an der dart entfernt; oben sein, bevor es hell wird.
line.tr: bu hafta güneş 07:50 civarında doğuyor. tepe, dart ile howth istasyonundan kısa bir yokuş; ışık gelmeden zirvede ol.

sparks.why: Sunrise 07:45 to 07:47 on 13 Nov (sunrise-and-sunset.com, General Blue, Alpenglow), a minute or two later by sunday. No weather forecast was found for this day, so none is claimed.
